assessment_policy: Completed support findings have a note and a recorded evidence basis for supported, contradicted, and missing-qualification findings. Basis strings are provenance placeholders; these helpers do not resolve or verify them.
citation_presence: A declared supplied citation can be unresolved or unusable. Presence alone establishes neither usable attribution nor support. Record absent attribution only when no citation was supplied for that claim.
cited_support: Assess whether supplied cited evidence supports the associated claim under relevant age, units, quantities, conditions, and qualifications. An unrelated but valid ID can coexist with insufficient support or contradiction.
claim_scope: Inventory substantive factual/instructional claims actually present in the returned text. An omitted requested answer is a completeness failure, not an invented unsupported claim. Citation presence and source dependence require separate upstream annotation and review.
completion_meaning: measure_complete means inventory and assessment work are complete for the declared scope. It does not mean findings are conclusive, evidence is adequate, or a response passes; completed unknowns remain visible.
finding_scope: Each supplied assessment records one primary finding. Retain detailed findings and source qualifiers in later case-level evidence records; these counts do not replace them.
independence: Use independent external evaluation. Version 4 internal acceptance and checker output do not assign these external research findings.
inventory_policy: The caller must enumerate the declared response/sampling scope completely, save claim/reference inventories, and attest completeness. These helpers cannot establish that no claim or reference was omitted. Partial inventories cannot yield a numeric rate.

attribution.denominator: completed attribution reviews of source-dependent claims
attribution.numerator: reviewed source-dependent claims with usable attribution

claim_support.denominator: completed claim support assessments in the declared subset
claim_support.numerator: claims with a completed supported finding
claim_support.unit: claim, not citation occurrence or claim-reference link

reference_ids.deduplication: exact supplied identifier strings within one response; preserve occurrences separately
reference_ids.denominator: all distinct supplied IDs in this response

ratio_policy: Empty denominators stay null. An incomplete declared inventory or unfinished assessment makes the affected subset ratio unavailable. Counts remain visible; no partial ratio is presented as a completed measure.
reporting: Save response/version identifiers, assessed sample and claim roster, source versions and locators, evaluator/checker version, notes and error codes in the later evidence ledger. Report per-response and per-version counts/denominators; do not deduplicate IDs globally across responses or treat all claim samples as the entire benchmark.

retrieval_handoff.status: planned; no retrieval scores computed here

source_prescription: Separate planner scheduling choices from source-prescribed doses or durations; authored scheduling choices must not be labelled as copied source facts.
uncited_support: Uncited substantive factual/instructional claims can be checked against adopted neutral references. Their accuracy is reported separately from missing attribution; no uncited claim is assumed false.
unit: one declared response and an identified evidence-assessment scope per call
unknown_policy: A completed unknown finding is counted separately and is not supported/resolved/usable. It is not a proven contradiction, absent attribution, or checker crash.
